breaking_news.headline: Court ruling freezes Paramount-Warner Bros. merger for now
breaking_news.summary: Paramount's owners were hoping they'd be firmly in control of rival Warner Bros. Discovery by the end of this week. Monday's temporary restraining order puts that plan on hold.

breaking_news.headline: Amid nurse shortage, a university rolls out the welcome mat for men
breaking_news.summary: Only about 1 in 8 nurses are men, but their share is growing. A strong job market for nurses and sustained efforts to recruit men into the field have made a difference, including in the South.

breaking_news.headline: The best economic ideas from around the world — Planet Money Summer School is back
breaking_news.summary: Our free economics course for your ears is on a quest for great economics ideas.

breaking_news.headline: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on Canadian goods
breaking_news.summary: President Donald Trump on Monday imposed 50% tariffs on most Canadian goods, declaring that Canada has unfairly discriminated against American autos, alcohol and dairy products.

breaking_news.headline: Staying in a job for the health insurance? About 1 in 4 Americans do, a survey says
breaking_news.summary: About 24% of U.S. employees stay in unwanted jobs just for health insurance, a report out Wednesday finds. Up significantly since 2021, the uptick in "job lock" is a concerning sign for the U.S. economy.

breaking_news.headline: In South Dakota, public media endures a year after federal funding was wiped out
breaking_news.summary: We check in on one state public broadcasting network a year after President Trump signed a law ending federal funding of public media.

breaking_news.headline: 'New York Times' alleges White House abuses legal system to intimidate reporters

breaking_news.headline: A town renamed its festival 'AI Love Irondale Day.' Then came the comments

breaking_news.headline: Ghanaians' ICC petition over migrant attacks 'opportunistic', says South Africa
breaking_news.summary: The petition argues the violence against migrants in South Africa could amount to crimes against humanity.

breaking_news.headline: South Korea woman acquitted of murdering newborn after hospital delivery
breaking_news.summary: The woman, who had wanted to end her pregnancy at 36 weeks, gave birth to a baby who doctors later killed.

breaking_news.headline: Russia's businesses under strain from Ukraine's attacks on Wildberries
breaking_news.summary: Ukrainian drones have hit several retail warehouses belonging to Russia's biggest online retailer Wildberries in a matter of days.

breaking_news.headline: Canada's 'powerful' dairy sector is in Trump's trade crosshairs
breaking_news.summary: Canada's dairy supply management system is in the spotlight after the US president singled it out as one of three main irritants used to justify new tariffs.

breaking_news.headline: 'I am still alive': Indian activist on hunger strike for 26 days loses 11kg
breaking_news.summary: Sonam Wangchuk has been the main draw at the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest in Delhi.

breaking_news.headline: France evacuates 20,000 as wildfires spread in south-west
breaking_news.summary: Most of those evacuated were tourists from campsites around Arcachon Bay in France's Gironde region.

breaking_news.headline: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudi tanker as US launches more Iran strikes
breaking_news.summary: The Iran-backed group, which previously announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia, also claims to have hit another vessel.

breaking_news.headline: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump

breaking_news.headline: Why the UK is dithering over what to do about e-scooters
